crossRefs.note: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened…
For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

translations.web: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
translations.bsb: At her feet he collapsed, he fell, there he lay still; at her feet he collapsed, he fell; where he collapsed, there he fell dead.
translations.kjv: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
translations.asv: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay; At her feet he bowed, he fell; Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
